name: Engrain
positioning: Interactive maps and virtual tours that show renters real-time pricing and availability across every listing channel.
description: Engrain builds leasing and asset visualization software for multifamily, senior living and build-to-rent operators. Its product line covers SightMap, an interactive site and unit map embedded on leasing websites and kiosks; TouchTour, a virtual tour builder for remote leasing; and Asset Intelligence, a data visualization layer for portfolio decisions.
real_estate_use: A leasing agent embeds SightMap on the community website so a prospect can click a building, see which units are available and at what price, and start an application without calling the office. During a remote search, the same prospect runs TouchTour to walk a unit virtually before booking an in-person visit. An asset manager separately uses Asset Intelligence to compare pricing and availability trends across a multifamily portfolio.
features: Real-time pricing and availability sync across channels

use_cases.job: Let a prospect browse real-time unit availability and pricing on an interactive map before touring
Compare pricing and availability trends across a multifamily portfolio
